name: Brand mention alert: new posts from a Juicer feed to Telegram

parameters.content:
## Brand mention alerts
Juicer keeps your feed synced in the background and calls this workflow when it finds new posts. No polling.

**Set up**
1. In Juicer, create a feed with keyword sources, for example Reddit Mentions / Keyword "your brand" and X @mentions. The Juicer node can do this too (Feed > Create, Source > Add).
2. Add your Juicer API key, then activate this workflow. The trigger registers its own webhook.
3. Set your Telegram chat ID.

Turn on AI moderation with a sentiment filter in the feed to get a sentiment on every post. Needs an HTTPS n8n URL (n8n Cloud works).
